email.body1:
Brad, saw Casepoint named Paul Colangelo CEO and shipped 100-plus new capabilities with generative AI search across the platform.

A leadership change plus a big release usually puts more accounts in play than the BD team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Casepoint off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brad, quick follow-up for Casepoint.

With a new CEO, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most BD teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your BD team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Brad, last bit of proof for Casepoint.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Casepoint's reply rate likely compares to other legal tech vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brad, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A leadership transition plus a major release is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a legal tech BD motion? I'll tailor it to Casepoint either way.
